metadata.description: Portage: find and buy things from real online stores over UCP, MCP and WebMCP, with the shopper in control of every payment.

plugins.name: buy
plugins.description: Find and buy products from online stores through the portage CLI: search, compare, dry-run, checkout, hand-off to your own browser, order tracking, with spending caps and hard guardrails. Ships two skills: buy, and the read-only shop-research for price, stock, store and order questions.
